abstract: Two-dimensional electrophoresis was used to find changes in protein synthesis occurring as pluripotent embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells differentiate to give embryoid bodies in vitro. 2-D patterns from other embryonic cell lines, and from the inner cell mass (ICM) cells of mouse embryos, were also analysed for the expression of those proteins showing some change during embryoid body formation and for overall differences between these and the EC cells. Most changes in protein synthesis occurred before 12 h but endoderm was not discerned morphologically on the outside of EC cell clumps until at least 18 h after their suspension. The number of changes occurring is small compared with the number of polypeptides resolved, but is in line with similar studies. Comparisons with nullipotent EC cells and an endodermal cell line have allowed these changes to be assigned, tentatively, to the different cell types within embryoid bodies, and may allow them to be used as markers of differentiation. Comparisons between the 2-D patterns derived from ICMs and EC cells reveal substantial differences between the two that might not have been expected from their developmental homology. The importance of these differences to their pluripotentiality is discussed.
abstract_ja: 二次元電気泳動を用いて、多能性胎児性癌（EC）細胞がin vitroで胚様体へ分化する際のタンパク質合成の変化を調べた。さらに、他の胚性細胞株およびマウス胚の内部細胞塊（ICM）細胞の二次元パターンも、変化を示したタンパク質の発現およびEC細胞との全般的な違いについて解析した。タンパク質合成の変化の大部分は12時間以前に起こったが、EC細胞塊の外側に内胚葉が形態学的に認められるのは懸濁後少なくとも18時間後であった。変化の数は解析したポリペプチド数に比べて少なく、類似の研究と一致している。無多能性（nullipotent）EC細胞および内胚葉細胞株との比較により、これらの変化を胚様体内の異なる細胞型に暫定的に割り当てることができ、分化マーカーとして利用できる可能性がある。ICMとEC細胞の二次元パターンの比較では、発生学的相同性から予想されなかったかもしれない実質的な違いが明らかになった。これらの違いの多能性に対する重要性について議論する。
